rationale: The change revises the object-category scheme and explicitly states that the vulnerable-road-user vs other-object distinction must be reassessed. In the baseline, H1-ORR2 depends on FR-7.2.2 via assumption H1-A2 and revalidation condition H1-RC2, which is triggered when FR-7.2.2 or the object-category scheme changes. The Evaluation Target and Phenomenon of Interest remain unchanged, so only H1-ORR2 requires revalidation.
